The source notes that these methods yield different results because interpolation is not commutative with the transfer function. Therefore, the method described in [S4] does not evaluate the composition operator (which involves the transfer function) *via* texture interpolation in the manner implied by the claim (which suggests the interpolation itself performs the composition/classification evaluation directly). Instead, it classifies first, then interpolates the classified values.
